content: No roadmaps have moved to Completed/ since OrthogonalL2Bases and I am continuing to look into why. There are a couple TauCetiRoadmap#262 and TauCetiRoadmap#278 which could be approved and would move forward. More generally it seems the problem is, there is no easily accessible and up to date status indicator which shows that a roadmap is done. The design provides for STATUS.md but, at least according to my agents, this is often not up to date because the generator in TauCetiProgress which updates it only looks at the busiest roadmaps, and when a roadmap is near or at completion it drops out of the scan. One could look at what targets in Suggested.lean are proven, but this requires downloading the repo and doing the Lean compilation. So, there seems to be something to fix here.
Thanks for looking into this. (Aside, to link to PRs you need to write out e.g. TauCetiRoadmap#262 and TauCetiRoadmap#278.)
I'm trying to get the STATUS.md files more reliably up-to-date. It' not just crowding out by the rapidly progress roadmaps: these just aren't running at all.

Michael R Douglas said:

One could look at what targets in Suggested.lean are proven

This would also give false positives: there's no requirement that Suggested.lean actually covers the whole roadmap.

I've also been curious about STATUS.md, but haven't pursued it since I'm on leave for another week or so. @Kim Morrison, let me know if it would help to have some more resources on this.

I've also been thinking about ways to make the information that will be in STATUS.md more digestible, such as some kind of graphical interface so that people can see progress across the whole project at a glance. But I think getting STATUS.md updated is the first step in making something like that happen.
The STATUS.md files are being updated now, so I did a scan and I found that IntegralLattices looks ready to close out. @Kim Morrison and the reviewer (GitHub handle @amlicata) check it out!
I also found that UniversalCovers STATUS.md says complete but it is not quite.

Okay. It looks like the UniversalCovers roadmap is a bit ambiguous on whether we just want recognition of K(G,1), or existence too. Let's be ambitious here. :-) I'll update the roadmap.

I have an agent making a few final changes for IntegralLattices as well. It is instructed to make the PRs closing both of these out.
Hey, strange request: Could you rename this thread? Everytime this pops up in my recents I think Tau Ceti will soon stop accepting any new road maps, but then remember it's not about that

I am looking for more completed roadmaps and it is actually not easy to do, because a roadmap states its targets in text and the library has them under different names. For example, 9 of the 26 OrthogonalL2Bases targets have different Lean names.
I started writing ledger files (example UniversalCovers.json) to keep track and not have to rederive this every time, and realized that it is metadata which should be public and in a repo. What do you think?
What about just updating the Roadmap files themselves to match what has landed?
Worth a try. Maybe it will help the agents reading the roadmaps.

OK, I made TauCetiRoadmap#402 which updates the roadmap for the OneParameterSemigroups project and also fixes a missing spec.
Does this set a good precedent?
